description: Figure 8 illustrates the performance of different audio-language models on the MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR datasets, represented as percentages. The horizontal axis displays the model names, listed alphabetically from “Alpaca” to “Whisper,” while the vertical axis represents the error rate, labeled as “Error (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, incrementing by 10 units. The chart consists of grouped bars for each model, with two bars per model: a light blue bar representing performance on MMAU and a dark blue bar representing performance on MMAR. For Alpaca, the MMAU error rate is approximately 54% and the MMAR error rate is around 34%. The error rates for other models vary; for example, for “LLaMA,” the MMAU error rate is approximately 43% and the MMAR error rate is around 31%, while for “Whisper,” the MMAU error rate is approximately 18% and the MMAR error rate is around 12%. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each model, allowing for a visual comparison of performance between the two datasets. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
